**Situation:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

**Actions taken:**

2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001): "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — the initial create call timed out, but the incident was confirmed created and is open.

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002. The incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.
